18205.note: Waterfront bait shop, bar and grill on the North Causeway with live music and kayak rentals, in a building tied to WWII naval training; its city land lease has been under review.
18205.fn: Reported (WFLX 2025, Islands 2025) to have been part of Fort Pierce for about 80 years, starting as a former WWII-era guard shack; no exact year confirmed.
